decisions.reason: The margin analysis still has its own page in 2024 and builds on the firm's market-data base, so it costs little to carry and its option value remains while demand is still uncertain.

Its demotion from its own page to a mention, while sibling tariff tools B, D and F were already removed, signals fading value, but it sits close to the core tariff-calculation offer and costs little to maintain, so the option is kept for now.

The area definition tool has also been downgraded to a mention, but it likely serves as a supporting module on the central platform at low carrying cost, so keeping it as an option is still justified.
